name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 6 visits over 45 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-06-27, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
